title: 雪寺无声

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮目视：双雪柱、居中女祭司、膝上闭合书与右侧石榴枝可见，雪台基向下连续；仅执行者选定母版，未做用户审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original full-frame opaque 1024x1536 vertical tarot illustration, High Priestess theme 雪寺无声 / Silent Snow Temple. Reference image is only identity/style guide: exactly one calm dark-haired veiled priestess in dark ink-blue and snow-white robes, sitting low and centered between EXACTLY TWO high ice-stone columns inside a quiet snow temple. She holds ONE fully closed book on her lap with two natural hands; a pomegranate branch provides a small warm deep-red focal accent beside her. Leave spacious snowy architecture and pale winter sky above; no sea, no ink pool, no mirrors. Solid carved stone seat and snow-covered plinth must connect continuously to the bottom bleed, with gown lying naturally on support. Palette snow white, ink blue, muted pomegranate red; luminous frosty air and restrained gold celestial tarot border. Painterly detailed fantasy art, near/mid/far space, clear book shape and column count. Only one woman, no extra figures, no illegible writing, title, letters, numbers, logo or watermark. One full opaque master image.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.

NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 人物、纱、手与闭合书一组；柱与远廊留背景；本主题支撑归属：石座及积雪台基不断开. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture.
